comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
screen.rs:21 calls `DEFAULT_SCROLLBACK` (10 MB) "Ghostty's own `scrollback-limit`, so the daemon's copy holds what the surface beside it holds". Ghostty's default is 50 MB, at the pin and at vt-1.0.0. With `scrollback_bytes` unset, a surface can hold 50 MB and a reattach replays 10 MB, silently shortening what the pane showed. Setting `scrollback_bytes` does not close the gap: it reaches the daemon, and nothing in Sources passes a limit to surfaces.

Raise the default to 50 MB once a_2vgzgocbC keeps that affordable, correct the comment, and decide whether `scrollback_bytes` also sets the surface's limit. a_26BJb6vEl's claim that the two hold the same history needs the same correction.
title: The daemon keeps 10 MB of scrollback where a surface keeps 50 MB, so a reattach shortens history
